metadata.title: CAR OS - Powertrain-Differentiated OBD-II Parameter Reference Knowledge Base
metadata.source_provenance: SAE J1979 / ISO 15031 Standards, carOBD Empirical Telemetry, and CAR OS Automotive Engineering Knowledge Base
metadata.document_note: Reference ranges compiled to fulfill Section D requirements. Note: OBD_Details_All_Cars.pdf was not present on disk; parameters are grounded in industry standards and empirical dataset telemetry.
metadata.disclaimer: OBD-II readings and reference ranges indicate electronic sensor parameters and circuit conditions. Deviations represent diagnostic indicators requiring physical verification by a certified technician, not conclusive proof of mechanical component failure.

engine_rpm.name: Engine RPM
engine_rpm.ev_note: Not applicable to Electric Vehicles. EVs do not possess an internal combustion crankshaft; motor RPM is communicated via proprietary BMS/inverter CAN IDs, not standard SAE J1979 PID 0x0C.
engine_rpm.hybrid_note: May read 0 RPM during EV drive mode or regenerative braking while vehicle is moving; this is normal hybrid operation.

vehicle_speed_kmh.name: Vehicle Speed
vehicle_speed_kmh.description: Road speed calculated from transmission output or ABS wheel sensors.

coolant_temp_c.name: Engine Coolant Temperature
coolant_temp_c.description: Temperature of engine liquid coolant jacket.
coolant_temp_c.ev_note: Not applicable to Electric Vehicles. EV thermal management uses dedicated high-voltage battery coolant loops (typically 20°C - 35°C) and power electronics cooling, not internal combustion engine coolant (PID 0x05).

battery_voltage.name: Auxiliary / Control Module Voltage
battery_voltage.description: 12-Volt low-voltage electrical accessory and ECU bus voltage.
battery_voltage.ev_note: CRITICAL EV/HYBRID SAFEGUARD: This parameter measures the 12V auxiliary lead-acid/LFP battery that powers lights, displays, and ECUs. It does NOT measure or represent the High-Voltage (300V-450V) Traction Battery State of Health (SOH) or State of Charge (SOC).

engine_load_pct.name: Calculated Engine Load
engine_load_pct.description: Percentage of peak available engine torque being utilized.
engine_load_pct.ev_note: Not applicable to Electric Vehicles. EV electric motor torque is managed by inverter field-oriented control, not SAE calculated load.

throttle_pos_pct.name: Absolute Throttle Position
throttle_pos_pct.description: Angle of engine intake throttle plate.
throttle_pos_pct.diesel_note: Most modern diesels are unthrottled during combustion; PID 0x11 indicates the anti-shudder/EGR mixing flap position only.
throttle_pos_pct.ev_note: EVs do not have a throttle plate. Driver demand is measured by Accelerator Pedal Position (APP), not throttle plate position.

fuel_system_status.name: Fuel System Control Loop Status
fuel_system_status.description: ECU feedback loop control status (Closed Loop using O2 sensors vs Open Loop).
valid_states: Open Loop (High load / Wide Open Throttle)
